# gezor_cluster (Data Source)

Looks up one cluster by id or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gezor_cluster" "prod" {
  name = "prod-eu"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Cluster id. Set `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Cluster name. Set `id` or `name`.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace id or slug. Defaults to the provider's `workspace`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `enabled_apps` (Set of String) Apps (modules) that are turned on.
- `environment` (String)
- `hosting_mode` (String)
- `online` (Boolean)
- `operator_namespace` (String)
- `operator_version` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `tags` (List of String)
